title: 第13章 焰焰许配你，如何？

content_zh:
西门焰焰一怒，小手握成粉拳几乎要发飙，但是想起了父亲的怒火，不由得强行忍住，冷道：“你不走，我走！”
随后，她重重地转身离去，镶着宝石的小蛮靴跺得太厉害，以至于甲板都有些震动。
西门焰焰走了，甲板上就只剩下阳顶天一个人。
“距离阴阳宗还有十五天的路程，海上的风景现在看着还可以，看多了就非常无聊了，因为太单调和枯燥了，尤其对于你们年轻人来说。”这艘船的主人西门无涯的声音在背后响起，不知道什么时候他走到了阳顶天的身后，其实他已经走出脚步声了。
“西门先生，您去阴阳宗做什么呢？”阳顶天问道，这本不应该是他该问的，毕竟交浅言深，不过他是年轻人，犯这种肤浅的错误也是应该的。
“例行公事，每十年一次。”西门无涯道：“就仿佛那些远行在外的游子，每隔几年都想回去祭祀一下祖宗，表示自己没有忘本。”
“您和阴阳宗有关系？”阳顶天问道。
“是云霄城和阴阳宗有关系。”西门无涯道：“很复杂的关系，是敌非敌，是友非友，是亲非亲。”
西门无涯这个非常睿智的人仿佛也犯了交浅言深的错误，和阳顶天说了这些话。
“云霄城历代主人每十年去阴阳宗，去一次受辱一次，我这次大概也不例外。”西门无涯缓缓道。
“您那么厉害？也会受辱？您的云霄城那么强大？”阳顶天问道，也一半是在试探。
西门无涯仿佛一点都不知道阳顶天是在试探，笑道：“在阴阳宗面前，谁敢说自己强大？”
阳顶天道：“阴阳宗有那么强？”
“假如一个门派拥有几千名子弟，百里疆域，十几万人仰其鼻息，那这个门派厉不厉害？”西门无涯问道。
“厉害，非常厉害。”阳顶天吸一口凉气道：“阴阳宗竟然这么强大？”
“不，我说的不是阴阳宗，而是一个门派，像这样的门派全天下有几十个。”西门无涯道：“准确说是二十七派，再往上是九大门，再往上是三大宗，隐宗，阴阳宗，玄天宗。天下三宗，宇内至尊，阴阳宗位列其中，你说厉害不厉害？”
这样，阳顶天是真正地倒吸一口凉气，之前听师父说起阴阳宗，他觉得或许阴阳宗还挺强的，但没有想到竟然强悍到这个地步。
“那东方涅灭呢？”阳顶天忍不住问道。
“天下第一！”西门无涯淡淡说了四个字。
阳顶天的内心直接被震撼了，自己的师父，竟然是天下第一强者！

但是，他既然是天下第一，为何又会被困在万里冰雪之下生不如死？他的敌人是谁？难道比天下第一还要厉害？
身心被震撼的阳顶天再也没有了说话的兴致，西门无涯微微一笑，轻轻地拍了拍肩膀，离开甲板到船舱去了。
“要刮风下雨了，下去吧。”
******
接下来几天，船上的所有人依旧对阳顶天非常冷淡，西门焰焰更是对他充满了厌恨。
而西门无涯依旧每天都来看他，和他聊聊天。而且从来不试图打探阳顶天的任何隐私，反而对阳顶天的任何问题有问必答。
两个人越聊越投缘，有些时候甚至会聊上大半天。
整艘船所有人都非常奇怪，为何贵为云霄城主的西门无涯要对一个来历不明的人如此之好？以至于西门炎对阳顶天已经完全充满了敌意，作为西门无涯的义子，他最敬仰的义父从来都没有对他那么好过，他真的充满了妒忌。
要不是西门城主极度洁身自好，甚至有些人都怀疑阳顶天是不是西门城主在外面的私生子了？
而对于阳顶天来说，虽然还对西门无涯充满了些许的戒备，但内心深处对这个人已经充满了好感，甚至还有点濡慕。在之前阳顶天不知道君子应该是什么样子的？现在他知道了，西门无涯完全可以是君子的代名词，和他相处真的是如沐春风，而且他还绝对不是伪君子。
不过，分别的时间很快就要到了，经过半个月的航行，阴阳宗所在的东方云州马上就要到了。
“不错，是个挺俊俏的小伙子了。”西门无涯望着镜子里面的阳顶天笑道。
马上要下船了，所以西门无涯亲自动刀给阳顶天刮掉了胡须，理了头发，还送给他一道很漂亮的袍服，还有一支内敛而又华丽的束发玉冠。

content_en:
Ximen Yanyan was so angry that he clenched his little hands into pink fists and almost went crazy, but remembering his father's anger, he couldn't help but hold it back and said coldly: "If you don't leave, I'll leave!"
Then, she turned around heavily and left, stamping her jewel-encrusted boots so hard that the deck shook.
Ximen Yanyan left, leaving Yang Dingtian alone on the deck.
"There are still fifteen days away from the Yin Yang Sect. The scenery on the sea is okay now, but it will be very boring if you see too much, because it is too monotonous and boring, especially for you young people." The voice of the owner of the ship, Ximen Wuya, sounded from behind. I don't know when he walked behind Yang Dingtian. In fact, he had already walked out of the footsteps.
"Mr. Ximen, what are you doing in the Yin Yang Sect?" Yang Dingtian asked. This shouldn't be a question he should ask. After all, it's easy to talk about deep things, but he is a young man and it is appropriate for him to make such superficial mistakes.
"It's a routine matter, once every ten years." Ximen Wuya said: "It's like those wanderers who travel far away and want to go back to worship their ancestors every few years to show that they have not forgotten their roots."
"Are you related to the Yin Yang Sect?" Yang Dingtian asked.
"It is the relationship between Yunxiao City and the Yin Yang Sect." Ximen Wuya said: "It is a very complicated relationship. They are enemies but not enemies, friends but not friends, and relatives but not relatives."
Ximen Wuya, a very wise man, seemed to have made the mistake of saying these things to Yang Dingtian.
"The previous masters of Yunxiao City went to the Yin Yang Sect every ten years and were humiliated every time they went there. I am probably no exception this time." Ximen Wuya said slowly.
"Are you so powerful? Are you going to be humiliated? Is your Yunxiao City so powerful?" Yang Dingtian asked, partly as a test.
Ximen Wuya didn't seem to know that Yang Dingtian was testing him, and said with a smile: "Who dares to say that he is strong in front of the Yin Yang Sect?"
Yang Dingtian said: "Is the Yin Yang Sect that strong?"
"If a sect has thousands of disciples, a territory of hundreds of miles, and hundreds of thousands of people looking up to it, then is this sect powerful?" Ximen Wuya asked.
"Amazing, very powerful." Yang Dingtian took a breath and said, "Is the Yin Yang Sect so powerful?"
"No, I'm not talking about the Yin Yang Sect, but a sect. There are dozens of sects like this in the world." Ximen Wuya said: "To be precise, there are twenty-seven sects, and above that are the nine gates, and above that are the three major sects, the Yin Sect, the Yin Yang Sect, and the Xuantian Sect. There are three sects in the world, and the Yin Yang Sect is among them. Do you think it is powerful or not?"
In this way, Yang Dingtian really took a breath. He heard his master talk about Yin Yang Sect before, and he thought that maybe Yin Yang Sect was quite strong, but he didn't expect it to be so strong.
"What about Dongfang Nirvana?" Yang Dingtian couldn't help but ask.
"Number one in the world!" Ximen Wuya said four words calmly.
Yang Dingtian was shocked in his heart. His master was actually the most powerful person in the world!
However, since he is the best in the world, why is he trapped under thousands of miles of ice and snow and his life is worse than death? Who is his enemy? Is it even more powerful than being number one in the world?
Yang Dingtian, who was shocked both physically and mentally, was no longer interested in talking. Ximen Wuya smiled slightly, patted his shoulder gently, and left the deck to the cabin.
"It's going to be windy and rainy, let's go down."
****
In the next few days, everyone on the ship was still very cold towards Yang Dingtian, and Ximen Yanyan was even more disgusted with him.
And Ximen Wuya still comes to see him every day and chat with him. And he never tried to inquire into any of Yang Dingtian's privacy. Instead, he answered all Yang Dingtian's questions.
The more the two chatted, the closer they became, and sometimes they would even chat for a long time.
Everyone on the ship was very surprised. Why did Ximen Wuya, the lord of Yunxiao City, treat a person of unknown origin so well? So much so that Ximen Yan was completely hostile to Yang Dingtian. As Ximen Wuya's adopted son,, his foster father, whom he admired most, had never been so kind to him, and he was really full of jealousy.
If it weren't for the fact that Lord Ximen was extremely clean and self-possessed, some people would even wonder if Yang Dingtian was the illegitimate son of Lord Ximen?
As for Yang Dingtian, although he was still a little wary of Ximen Wuya, deep down in his heart he was already full of affection for this person, and even a little envious. Yang Dingtian didn't know what a gentleman should look like before? Now he knows that Ximen Wuya can be synonymous with a gentleman, and getting along with him is really like a breath of fresh air, and he is definitely not a hypocrite.
However, the time for separation is coming soon. After half a month of sailing, Dongfang Yunzhou, where the Yin Yang Sect is located, is about to arrive.
"Yes, he is a pretty handsome young man." Ximen Wuya looked at Yang Dingtian in the mirror and said with a smile.
They were about to disembark, so Ximen Wuya personally shaved off Yang Dingtian's beard and trimmed his hair. He also gave him a beautiful robe and a restrained yet gorgeous jade crown for his hair.
